title: Import the full EPP workspace corpus
goal: Bring the full EPP Markdown corpus, project metadata, extracted source context, regulatory sources, and original catalog source files into a standalone Archivist workspace.
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable import script can rebuild the full EPP workspace from the original repo
The imported workspace manifest includes every catalog document from the EPP project catalog
Project metadata needed for navigation, search, compliance, placeholders, sources, artifacts, and requirements is copied with the workspace
Original catalog source files are copied when present and missing source files are reported in the manifest
The seed workspace remains available for fast scaffold testing
non_goals: Rendering every imported document in the React UI in this slice
Porting all artifact widgets in this slice
Changing canonical Markdown content during import
validation: Confirm workspaces/epp-full/workspace.json document_count matches the EPP catalog
notes: This slice records the user's full-content decision and makes the import refreshable rather than a one-off copy.
